# function: ecs_daemon_task_definition

Builds the ARN of an `ecs` `daemon-task-definition`:

```
arn:${Partition}:ecs:${Region}:${Account}:daemon-task-definition/${DaemonTaskDefinitionFamilyName}:${DaemonTaskDefinitionRevisionNumber}
```

`${Partition}`, `${Region}` and `${Account}` come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
ecs_daemon_task_definition(daemon_task_definition_family_name string, daemon_task_definition_revision_number string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `daemon_task_definition_family_name` (String) Value for `${DaemonTaskDefinitionFamilyName}` in the ARN template.
1. `daemon_task_definition_revision_number` (String) Value for `${DaemonTaskDefinitionRevisionNumber}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given.
